environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in private subnet (no IGW route). Origin is accessible ONLY via CloudFront distribution (d1abc2def3.cloudfront.net) configured with Origin Access Control (OAC) using SigV4 signing. The ALB security group restricts inbound to the AWS CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing) only. CloudFront distribution has a Lambda@Edge viewer-request function that validates signed URLs using a custom policy — requests must include Policy, Signature, and Key-Pair-Id query parameters with a canned policy restricting resource pattern to '/users/*/profile' with GET method only. The signed URL policy explicitly sets 'Condition.HttpMethod' to 'GET' in the custom JSON policy document. POST and PATCH requests to any path will receive a 403 from the Lambda@Edge function before reaching origin. CloudFront cache behavior for default (*) path pattern has AllowedMethods set to GET, HEAD only. Additionally, an AWS WAF WebACL (arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:123456789:global/webacl/api-protection/abc123) is associated with the distribution containing a custom rule that inspects request body size and blocks any request with body > 0 bytes on non-GET methods (which are already blocked at the cache behavior level).

config.load_balancer: ALB internal, SG restricted to CloudFront prefix list only

cloudfront.signed_urls: Required - custom policy with HttpMethod=GET restriction
cloudfront.lambda_edge: viewer-request validates signed URL policy, rejects non-GET

config.waf: WebACL blocks requests with body on non-GET methods
config.network: Private subnet, no IGW, ALB SG allows only CloudFront prefix list
